profile_text.body:
Symbotic Inc. is a public company headquartered in Wilmington, Massachusetts, that trades under the ticker SYM and describes itself on its website as a provider of end-to-end warehouse automation. The company says its systems combine dense storage, streamlined operations, and AI-enhanced software to increase facility capacity and throughput for retailers and distributors. It states that its solutions can be adapted to palletized goods, small quantity fulfillment, and omnichannel operations, handling items from 1 lb (0.5 kg) and 2 x 6.4 x 5 in (5.1 x 16.3 x 12.7 cm) up to 60 lb (27.2 kg) and 36 x 24 x 16.2 in (91.4 x 61 x 41.2 cm) in their native packaging, with options for loose items and cold chain requirements.

The company describes itself as the software and key robotic innovator for each solution it sells, positioning its turnkey offering against typical integrators that it says are limited by their portfolio of technology partnerships. It states that it is innovating through robotics and AI for material handling logistics, and describes its purpose as getting the right goods to people who need them when they need them. It also describes itself as a leader in industrial automation and in technology at large.

Corporate records list the company as a for-profit public company with CIK 0001837240. Its recorded litigation exposure is in Massachusetts, where 191 cases are counted.
